title: The Midnight Training Ground Mystery
hook: They said Danny Welbeck vanished after midnight training... but the security footage shows something impossible.
story_text: Danny stayed late for extra practice. Alone in the empty stadium. The floodlights flickered. Then—footsteps behind him. He turned. No one there. The camera caught his shadow on the wall. But it wasn't moving like Danny's. It was running. Sprinting. Toward the tunnel. The coaches found him unconscious at dawn. No memory. Just one word on his lips: 'Finish him.' The shadow had his jersey. But it wasn't him.
call_to_action: What do YOU think happened that night at the training ground? Drop your theory below! 🔴
